projects.title: Transformer Translation Model
projects.subtitle: English-to-Hindi Neural Translator
projects.description: Engineered an encoder-decoder Transformer from scratch in PyTorch with custom multi-head attention, causal masking, beam search, and a FastAPI inference backend.
highlights: Engineered an encoder-decoder Transformer from scratch in PyTorch.
Implemented custom multi-head attention, sinusoidal positional encoding, causal masking, and BPE-based subword tokenization.
Trained on 197K+ cleaned English-Hindi sentence pairs using CUDA and cross-entropy optimization.
Implemented autoregressive decoding and beam search for sequence generation.
Built a FastAPI inference backend and React frontend, integrating model checkpoint loading and GPU-accelerated translation.

highlights: Built a production-deployed multi-agent AI platform for personalized student mentoring, skill-gap analysis, learning roadmaps, AI tutoring, and career recommendations.
Engineered a seven-agent architecture for student assessment, roadmap generation, tutoring, quiz generation, evaluation, and recommendations.
Developed a React + Vite frontend and PostgreSQL backend with REST APIs, JWT authentication, bcrypt password hashing, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic validation.
Containerized the backend with Docker and deployed using Render and Vercel.
